keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «사막의 동식물은 수천 년 동안 이 문제를 해결해 왔다(주제)» 와 «사막은 영리하게 적응해 살아남은 생명으로 가득하다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (desert plants and animals have been solving this problem for thousands of years) and the conclusion (deserts are full of life that adapted in clever ways to survive). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why can a camel travel for days without food?
qs.qko: 낙타가 며칠 동안 먹지 않고도 이동할 수 있는 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because it sleeps underground all day
evs: A camel's hump stores fat, not water, so it can travel for days without food.
Cactuses store water in their thick stems, and their spines lose far less water than leaves.
The tiny fennec fox has huge ears that let body heat escape.
Scientists call any place with very little rain a desert, usually less than 250 millimeters a year.
why: 낙타의 혹에는 물이 아니라 지방이 저장되어 있어서 며칠 동안 먹지 않고도 이동할 수 있다고 했어요.
A camel's hump stores fat, not water, so it can travel for days without food.

qs.q: In "Now for the twist: a desert does not have to be hot!" what does "twist" mean?
qs.qko: «Now for the twist: a desert does not have to be hot!» 에서 «twist» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: a surprising fact you did not expect
evs: By that rule, the largest desert on Earth is the frozen continent of Antarctica.
The sun is burning, there is no shade, and you have only one bottle of water.
Cactuses store water in their thick stems, and their spines lose far less water than leaves.
Many animals hide underground during the day and come out in the cool night, which is a smart lesson for you too.
why: 뜨거운 사막 이야기를 하다가, 지구에서 가장 큰 사막이 꽁꽁 언 남극이라는 뜻밖의 사실이 나와요. 그래서 «twist» 는 «예상 못 한 반전» 이에요.
After talking about hot deserts, the text surprises us: the largest desert is frozen Antarctica. So «twist» means a surprising fact you did not expect.

qs.q: Why is Antarctica called a desert even though it is frozen?
qs.qko: 남극은 꽁꽁 얼어 있는데도 왜 사막이라고 불리나요?
opts: Because a desert is any place with very little rain, and Antarctica fits that rule
Because Antarctica is covered with hot sand
evs: Scientists call any place with very little rain a desert, usually less than 250 millimeters a year.
A camel's hump stores fat, not water, so it can travel for days without food.
By that rule, the largest desert on Earth is the frozen continent of Antarctica.
Desert plants and animals have been solving this problem for thousands of years.
why: 과학자들은 비가 아주 적게 오는 곳을 사막이라고 부르고, 그 기준에 따르면 가장 큰 사막은 남극이에요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Scientists call any place with very little rain a desert, and by that rule the largest desert is Antarctica. You need both sentences.

ends: How do people live in the hot Sahara Desert?
사람들은 뜨거운 사하라 사막에서 어떻게 살아갈까요?
What animals can live in the frozen desert of Antarctica?
꽁꽁 언 사막인 남극에는 어떤 동물이 살 수 있을까요?
